meta.parties: Hameedu Lebbe Et Al. v. Adam Saibo

rules.statement: In considering whether premises are reasonably required for the use of the landlord under section 8(c) of the Rent Restriction Ordinance, factors such as the landlord's intention to start a new business and the lack of alternative accommodation should be weighed.
rules.supporting_quote: "And so far as concerns the question of alternative accommodation I would guard against saying that the Cour t must satisfy itself (as it must under the English Acts) that there is alternative accommodation for the tenant before ordering eviction under section 8 (c). That is not the position. A case might well occur where, after duly considering the fact that there was no alternative accommodation, the Court might still consider that the landlord's requirement was reasonable."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 8 (c) of the Rent Restriction Ordinance
